survivors.line: if (!outer || !inner) return false;  (and the final return false of holds)
survivors.why: holds: a missing outer or inner node gives false whether the guard says || or && or is gone, and no caller passes a missing node; the last return false only turns false into undefined and every caller asks only for truthiness (four changes accepted).

survivors.line: if (made.getUTCFullYear() !== y || made.getUTCMonth() !== m - 1 || made.getUTCDate() !== d) return null;
survivors.why: anIsoDay: a date that rolls over always moves the year, or the month and the day together; || to && on the last pair changes nothing.
